sloka: कथं सागरमक्षोभ्यं तराम वरुणालयम् ।सैन्यैः परिवृताः सर्वे वानराणां महौजसाम् ।। ६.१९.३० ।।।।
transliteration: kathaṁ sāgaramakṣobhyaṁ tarāma varuṇālayam ।sainyaiḥ parivṛtāḥ sarve vānarāṇāṁ mahaujasām ।। 6.19.30 ।।।।

translations.english: (Hanuman) having asked so, righteous Vibheeshana said, "O king Raghava We ought to go and seek refuge from the god of the ocean."
